meta.plot: Les campeurs abandonnent Isla Nublar sans regret… Mais ils s'échouent vite sur un nouveau territoire étrange, pullulant de menaces et truffé de secrets bien gardés.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E01 - Camp Cretaceous
1.plot: After waiting his whole life to see dinosaurs, lucky Darius wins the chance to join five other campers on Isla Nublar for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E02 - Secrets
1.plot: With the rest of the crew off visiting a genetics lab, Kenji sneaks Darius into the park's top-secret underbelly — and straight into danger.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E03 - The Cattle Drive
1.plot: The campers hop into their Gyrospheres to help move a dinosaur herd toward fresh grazing lands. But an incoming storm stirs up unexpected trouble.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E04 - Things Fall Apart
1.plot: Darius remembers the promise he made to his dad. Elsewhere on the island, the campers find themselves face-to-face with a newly freed threat.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E05 - Happy Birthday, Eddie!
1.plot: After a close encounter with the Indominus, the gang seeks shelter in the genetics lab, where a strange scientist reveals the truth about Dr. Wu.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E06 - Welcome to Jurassic World
1.plot: Sammy's secret shocks everyone — but there's no time for anger when an accident unleashes a flock of Pteranodons and forces the crew below ground.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E07 - Last Day of Camp
1.plot: The campers leave the Mosasaurus lagoon and fight their way onto the monorail … where Ben gets a chance to face his fears.

1.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S01E08 - End of the Line
1.plot: It's a race against time as the campers make their way to the main dock to catch the last ferry leaving the island. But what if they're too late?

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E01 - A Beacon of Hope
2.plot: Still stranded on the island — and still reeling from the apparent loss of Ben — the campers make a last-ditch attempt at rescue by sending out an SOS.

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E02 - The Art of Chill
2.plot: Darius and Sammy face a moral dilemma while searching the park for supplies. The campers start building a new treehouse. Brooklynn sees something odd.

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E03 - The Watering Hole
2.plot: Brooklynn, Sammy and Yasmina team up to investigate strange noises in the park. Elsewhere, Darius and Kenji go exploring and witness a majestic sight.

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E04 - Salvation
2.plot: A bonfire in the distance signals that the campers have company: a pair of posh eco-tourists and their disgruntled security guy. But can they be trusted?

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E05 - Brave
2.plot: The campers reunite with a long-lost friend, who shares an inspiring story — then reveals that Mitch, Tiff and Hap aren't who they seem.

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E06 - Misguided
2.plot: Darius must make a difficult choice to save Sammy and Yasmina. Meanwhile, the remaining campers are trying to decide if Hap is a friend... or a foe.

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E07 - Step One
2.plot: Brooklynn, Ben, Kenji and Yasmina work to uncover a secret and restore power to the park as Darius leads Mitch and Tiff straight into a T. rex trap.

2.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S02E08 - Chaos Theory
2.plot: A guilty Darius is determined to protect the island's innocent dinos — even if he has to do it all alone. But with luck, maybe he won't have to...

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E01 - View from the Top
3.plot: The campers catch a lift to Lookout Point in search of materials to make a sail, then must quickly find a way back down. Ben worries about leaving Bumpy.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E02 - Safe Harbor
3.plot: After finding Mitch and Tiff's abandoned yacht, the happy campers celebrate. But the party's over when something big goes bump in the night.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E03 - Casa De Kenji
3.plot: Kenji takes the campers to his father's penthouse to gather supplies — but they've soon got company. Sammy reflects on what life must be like back home.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E04 - Clever Girl
3.plot: A thrilling chase brings Darius, Kenji and Yaz to the old Jurassic Park Visitors Center. Elsewhere on the island, Brooklynn and Sammy find a secret lab.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E05 - Eye of the Storm
3.plot: Sammy and Brooklynn rush to warn the others about a sinister new threat while Darius, unaware of the danger, searches for his dad's favorite dinosaur.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E06 - The Long Run
3.plot: As a poisoned camper fights to survive, it's up to Yaz — the fastest among them — to fetch the antidote before it's too late.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E07 - A Shock to the System
3.plot: It's crunch time for the campers to get to the boat and make their escape... until Ben disappears, deciding he'd rather stay. Can Darius change his mind?

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E08 - Escape from Isla Nublar
3.plot: With multiple threats running rampant on the island, dinosaur lover Darius must put his feelings aside and make a difficult decision.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E09 - Whatever It Takes
3.plot: The group is forced to switch gears when a familiar face returns to Isla Nublar. Now, getting off the island is no longer the most important thing.

3.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S03E10 - Stay on Mission
3.plot: With Brooklynn being held prisoner, the remaining campers hatch a plan to rescue her — and it won't be easy.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E01 - Beneath the Surface
4.plot: Out at sea, the campers see sunny skies... then discover a stowaway on board. A surprise attack from the deep leaves them stranded on unfamiliar shores.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E02 - At Least...
4.plot: The weary crew dodges danger in the desert while trying to figure out where they are. But they unearth more questions than answers.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E03 - Turning Dr. Turner
4.plot: A strange tunnel takes the teens to a lush forest, where they meet a mysterious scientist studying dino behavior. The question is: Can they trust her?

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E04 - Rude Awakening
4.plot: With Dr. Turner's help, the campers hatch a plan to get off the island that finds them crossing a snowy arctic biome — and making a selfless rescue.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E05 - The Long Game
4.plot: After learning the truth about Mae's boss, Sammy's ready to go rogue to take him down... just as Mae gets ready to confront him. Cue the killer robots!

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E06 - Mission Critical
4.plot: With Mae in serious condition and Kash's end game clear, the campers vow to save the dinosaurs and stop Mantah Corp. But evil BRADs are everywhere.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E07 - Staying Alive
4.plot: Darius has to think fast to distract Kash and protect the others, so he pretends to hate dinos as much as Kash does — while learning everything he can.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E08 - Technical Difficulties
4.plot: Brooklynn must devise a hack to help Darius, who's being tailed by an upgraded BRAD-X. Meanwhile, Kash prepares to woo a group of dangerous investors.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E09 - Dino-Sitting
4.plot: Darius keeps Kash busy with competitive video gaming while the others break into the nursery. Yaz asks Brooklynn how she feels about Kenji.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E10 - Taking Control
4.plot: Ben's refusal to bond with a new friend leads to regret — and a realization that it's time to take Kash down. Kenji and Brooklynn face their feelings.

4.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S04E11 - Who's the Boss?
4.plot: Just when it feels like things are getting back to normal, Kash's boss arrives on Mantah Corp. island and begins moving forward with a devastating plan.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E01 - Reunited
5.plot: Kenji's thrilled to see his father - and eager to prove himself. Elsewhere, Sammy and Brooklynn team up to find out what happened to Sammy's family.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E02 - The Final Test
5.plot: A cryptic clue prompts Brooklynn, Darius and Ben to dig into Mr. Kon's motives. Kenji plans a date with Brooklynn while helping his dad prep for a party.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E03 - Battle Lines
5.plot: Kenji asks his friends to back off and stay out of his father's business. But to save the island's dinos, they're willing to risk breaking his trust.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E04 - Evasive Action
5.plot: A stunning betrayal lands the friends in lockdown, where they unpack their feelings and plot their escape. Kenji follows his father to Isla Nublar.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E05 - Shaky Ground
5.plot: Something unsettling is sending the dinos into a frenzy. Darius and Brooklynn pour their energies into problem-solving. Kenji chooses sides.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E06 - Out of the Pack
5.plot: Kenji accepts an important assignment - and drives straight into danger. Back on Mantah Corp. Island, the others race to ruin Mr, Kon's plans.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E07 - The Leap
5.plot: The Kids come up with a plan to protect the dinosaurs. Left on her own, Sammy will have to rely on her own strength. Yaz opens up to Ben.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E08 - Clean Break
5.plot: An Increasingly suspicious Kenji starts looking into his father's activities. Mae works to break free from Kon's control and follow her heart.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E09 - The Core
5.plot: Yaz is ready to tell Sammy the truth - but the island has other plans. A conflicted Darius worries that he's lost his way.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E10 - Arrival
5.plot: The friends must think fast to outwit Mr. Kon and his cronies. Ben sets out to rescue an old friend - and gets help from a surprising source.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E11 - The Last Stand
5.plot: A high-stakes battle begins for control of Mantah Corp. Island. Kenji's ready to rejoin his friends, but Darius isn't sure he can forgive him.

5.title: FR - Jurassic World : La Colo du Crétacé - S05E12 - The Nublar Six
5.plot: With the future of the Island at steak, the friends band together - and fight harder than ever before - to protect what's really important.

meta.plot: "The Drop: A Snowfall Saga" retrouve Wanda Bell et Leon Simmons de "Snowfall" en pleine réinvention dans le Los Angeles des années 90. Alors que les ravages du crack s'estompent, un nouveau jeu émerge : l'essor du rap de la côte Ouest. Convaincue que la musique peut changer la culture américaine, Wanda rassemble une bande de génies hétéroclites pour réaliser leurs rêves. Pour y arriver, elle doit naviguer entre le monde de la musique et les codes de la rue, entraînant ses cousins Lamar et James Kinsey et courtisant Artillery, un rappeur local au sang chaud déjà dans le viseur de la police. Son stage chez l'ex-dealer devenu patron de label Darryl "DG" Grant lui ouvre des portes, mais creuse les tensions avec Leon. Ce dernier a juré de quitter la rue pour de bon et cherche la rédemption via son cabinet d'aide juridique gratuit. Ambition, loyauté et survie s'entrechoquent : chacun est prêt à tout risquer pour bâtir un avenir.

1.plot: After his untimely death, our unlikely hero finds himself in another world, reincarnated as a vending machine. Now his life revolves around selling things to people, but he's stuck in the middle of nowhere with no sign of any customers.

meta.plot: Échangé avec l’enfant d’une autre famille lorsqu’il était bébé, Nagi Umino rencontre enfin ses parents biologiques. Ce jour-là, il fait aussi la connaissance d’Erika Amano, l’autre bébé avec lequel il avait été échangé. Nagi apprend surtout que leurs deux familles ont décidé unilatéralement de fiancer les deux enfants ! Les voilà obligés de vivre ensemble : Nagi le lycéen sérieux et Erika au caractère fougueux. Qu’adviendra-t-il de ce drôle de couple ?

meta.plot: Au pied de la ville d’Orse s’étend l’abysse, une faille gigantesque à la profondeur inconnue habitée par d’étranges créatures et emplie d’antiques reliques. Depuis des années, ce gouffre attire de nombreux aventuriers séduits par l’aura de mystère qui l’entoure. On les appelle « les caverniers ». C’est ici que vit Rico, une jeune orpheline obsédée par l’Abysse et désirant marcher dans les traces de sa mère. Un jour, lors de ses prospections, elle découvre le corps inanimé d’un jeune garçon. Elle n’imagine alors pas à quel point cette découverte va changer sa vie et accélérer son destin...

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E01 - La Cité de l'abîme
1.plot: Rico, apprentie cavernière, part pour sa première exploration en solo dans l'Abysse. Son but est de ramener le plus grand nombre de reliques, mais alors qu'elle sauve son ami d'une créature locale, elle va faire une rencontre surprenante.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E02 - La fête de la renaissance
1.plot: Les enfants trouvent un moyen astucieux de cacher Légu, de peur qu'il ne soit considéré comme une relique.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E03 - Départ
1.plot: Persuadée que le petit mot trouvé dans le ballon d'informations de sa mère lui est destiné, Rico a bien l'intention de le suivre à la lettre.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E04 - Le bord de l'Abysse
1.plot: Rico et Légu entament leur descente dans l'Abysse, mais ils ne seront pas tranquilles tant qu'ils n'auront pas atteint le 2e niveau, où personne ne viendra les chercher.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E05 - L'incinérateur
1.plot: Le 2e niveau a été atteint sans encombre, mais il reste encore du chemin à parcourir avant d'arriver au poste d'observation, et les animaux de l'Abysse ne pardonnent pas les intrusions sur leur territoire.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E06 - Le camp d'explorateur
1.plot: Rico et Légu sont arrivés au camp d'explorateur du 2e niveau et vont faire la connaissance d'Ozen l'immobile, auprès de qui Rico va tenter de récolter des informations sur sa mère.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E07 - Le Seigneur figé
1.plot: Ozen l'immobile révèle un grand secret à Rico et Légu, avant de les juger inaptes à continuer leur chemin.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E08 - Entraînement de survie
1.plot: Pendant que Rico et Légu tentent de survivre seuls derrière le camp d'explorateurs, on en apprend plus sur le passé d'Ozen et Lisa.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E09 - La Grande Fissure
1.plot: Rico et Légu quittent le camp d'explorateurs pour continuer leur descente. La faune de la grande fissure n'est cependant pas très accueillante.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E10 - Poison et malédiction
1.plot: Arrivés au 4e niveau, Rico et Légu tombent sur un animal des plus dangereux, une espèce ayant déjà tué des centaines de caverniers…

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E11 - Nanatchy
1.plot: Nanatchy, un être mystérieux, est apparu pour aider Légu à sauver Rico de la mort, de justesse. Mais il y a encore beaucoup à faire pour que la jeune cavernière guérisse du poison sans perdre sa main.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E12 - La Véritable Malédiction
1.plot: En attendant le rétablissement de Rico, Légu demande à Nanatchy de lui en apprendre plus sur la malédiction de l'Abysse.

1.title: FR - Made In Abyss - S01E13 - Braver les tréfonds
1.plot: Alors que Légu hésite à accéder à la requête de Nanatchy, le passé des deux caverniers perdus nous est révélé.

meta.plot: Une plongée dans l’histoire de Michel Platini, légende du football mondial, racontée par Platini lui-même et ses plus illustres coéquipiers et adversaires.

1.title: FR - Platini - S01E01 - Aldo’s son
1.plot:
At age 27, Michel Platini set off into the unknown to join Juventus in Turin. Settling in proved much more difficult than expected. But the French No. 10 had no intention of giving up either his vision of soccer or his temperament, both of which were shaped in Lorraine within a family of Italian immigrants.

)

1.title: FR - Platini - S01E02 - Becoming Platini
1.plot: In 1975, France was a minor player on the world soccer stage when a young playmaker began to make a name for himself at Nancy. He quickly became the leader who was expected to lead Les Bleus back to the World Cup. But was the new star of French soccer ready to handle the pressure that came with his new status?

1.title: FR - Platini - S01E03 - Always Win
1.plot: Tensions rose when the new leader of Les Bleus was unable to prevent a disastrous start to the 1982 World Cup. In a now-legendary semifinal against Germany, and during the European Championship—held in France for the first time—Platini tried to instill in his teammates his obsession with winning.

1.title: FR - Platini - S01E04 - The Haunted King
1.plot: Platini was criticized in France for leaving to play in Turin, but was adored in Italy, where he is now nicknamed “The King.” There, he shone against Maradona, Zico, and Rummenigge, displaying a level of tactical intelligence unmatched anywhere in the world. But Juventus was obsessed with the European Champions Cup, which always eluded them. A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity arose in 1985, in the final in Brussels at Heysel Stadium.

1.title: FR - Platini - S01E05 - New worlds
1.plot: Platini became a global superstar by winning the Intercontinental Cup in Japan, leading the French national team at the World Cup in Mexico, launching his own television show, and becoming one of the faces of Restos du cœur. But even his third Ballon d’Or couldn’t erase the weariness that was increasingly taking hold of him.

1.title: FR - Platini - S01E06 - Politics
1.plot: With his soccer career over at just 32, Platini was named head coach of the French national team. Soon after, he entered the world of politics. In 2007, his election as president of UEFA, the governing body of European soccer, marked a first for a former soccer player. But the next step—toward FIFA—proved to be more complicated than he had imagined.

meta.plot: En 2016, Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe est arrachée à sa fille de 22 mois et emprisonnée à tort en Iran. À Londres, son mari Richard refuse de se taire et lance une campagne mondiale pour sa libération. Propulsée sous les projecteurs par des circonstances extraordinaires, cette histoire vraie est un vibrant témoignage de courage et de résilience face à l’injustice.

1.title: FR - Prisonnière 951 - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A woman is torn from her baby, accused of crimes she didn’t commit and imprisoned in Iran. In London, her husband refuses to stay silent. So begins a campaign to free her.

1.title: FR - Prisonnière 951 - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Locked in solitary after her transfer to Evin Prison, a hopeless Nazanin takes drastic action. In London, Richard uncovers the reason for his wife’s abduction.

1.title: FR - Prisonnière 951 - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Nazanin’s solitary ends, and she finds solace among fellow inmates. In London, a careless comment from an MP risks derailing her case. Richard and Nazanin make an agonising family decision.

1.title: FR - Prisonnière 951 - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Nazanin, still imprisoned, is heartbroken when her daughter returns to the UK. Richard must learn to be a dad again and decides to go on hunger strike to get his wife home.

meta.plot: Three months have passed since the Demon Lord was struck down, and the Demon Realm is holding a tournament to select his replacement. The leading contestant is Helck, a human hero who claims to hate his own kind. Some aren't happy with the idea of a human becoming the next Demon Lord—especially Vermilio the Red. She wants nothing more than to protect demonkind and prove Helck to be their enemy, even if she has to rig the competition to do it!

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E01 - Helck the Hero
1.plot: The Demon Lord is defeated by a human hero. To find his replacement, the demonkin hold a competition. Helck, a human and mortal enemy, is among the participants.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E02 - Anne From Management
1.plot: Helck continues to rack up victories as a fan favorite of the crowd. He then proceeds on to the semifinal race! Will he be able to keep up with the other racers?

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E03 - The Unknown Enemy
1.plot: Helck displays mind-blowing strength and leaves Vermilio increasingly concerned about the threat he poses.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E04 - Shock
1.plot: After Helck blocks an attack meant for Edil, Vermilio becomes convinced that he is an enemy. But then, the floor gives away and everyone falls into a dark underground room...

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E05 - The Remote Island Village
1.plot: The mysterious power of the gate sends Vermilio and Helck to an unknown remote island. Vermilio travels deeper into the island and comes across a fluffy creature.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E06 - Invasion
1.plot: Vermilio poses a question to Helck: “Can you fight against your old friends?” Meanwhile, the others at Castle Urum are fighting an overwhelming number of winged knights.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E07 - The Human King
1.plot: Hyura and the others escape Castle Urum but soon find themselves surrounded again. Azudra arrives to subdue the winged knights. All the while, Azudra begins plotting.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E08 - Back to the Continent
1.plot: Azudra determines the winged knights are a major threat. Meanwhile, Helck and Vermilio take it easy.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E09 - Barbarians of the Tothman Tribe
1.plot: Helck and Vermilio bid farewell to the mysterious island and its residents as they sail away with a stowaway Piwi aboard. However, they run into a massive whirlpool!

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E10 - In Pursuit of a Map
1.plot: Helck and company end up in the Erille Kingdom where they must fight the barbarians of the Tothman Tribe. The Tothman King goes berserk after tapping into a mysterious power.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E11 - The Troubadour's Song
1.plot: Helck and company use their winnings from the cooking competition to buy a map leading to the Empire. They make plans to go northwest into the ruins of two destroyed kingdoms.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E12 - The Spirit of Faith
1.plot: Vermilio is frightened by Helck's power as he goes berserk during his battle with Augis. It makes her recall the words of the Great Witch, who warned her about Helck.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E13 - With Younger Brother in Tow
1.plot: When they were little, Helck and his younger brother Cless lost both of their parents. One day, Cless gets very sick and Helck begs for someone to save him.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E14 - The Mercenaries
1.plot: Only half a month after Cless departs on his expedition, monsters begin to appear in greater numbers than ever before. The kingdom enacts a military draft to combat them.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E15 - The Power of Heroes
1.plot: Helck arrives at the Demon Lord’s castle and senses a powerful presence. It turns out to be Azudra of the Four Elite Lords, who makes a plea for peace.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E16 - The Truth Behind Awakening
1.plot: Zeruzeon reveals the kingdom’s terrifying plan, so Helck and his friends sneak into the castle to put a stop to it by saving Cless.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E17 - Traitors
1.plot: Helck is on the verge of being killed. To save the life of his big brother, Cless is forced to make a choice.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E18 - Smile
1.plot: Helck charges onward but an army of bounty hunters stands between him and Alicia. She is in horrible shape as she faces public execution.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E19 - Vermilio of the Four Elite Lords
1.plot: Helck's motivations become clear with an awakening of a horrific truth. Vermilio vows to fight by Helck’s side.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E20 - The Mysterious Woman
1.plot: The winged knights continue attacking Castle Thor to level themselves up further. Meanwhile, Asta keeps snooping for information in the human realm.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E21 - Phase 2
1.plot: Zeruzeon leads the winged knights in an assault on the newly rebuilt castle. Humans and demons become locked in combat.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E22 - Spell Breaker
1.plot: Hyura and Edil battle it out at Castle Thor while a strange relationship starts between them. Meanwhile, Mikaros is confronted by Azudra and reveals a past grudge.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E23 - The Chosen Path
1.plot: Raphaed’s army attacks a demonkin outpost, when Helck and Vermilio arrive. Raphaed determines Vermilio is Helck's newfound source of support.

1.title: FR - Helck - S01E24 - Towards a Hopeful Future
1.plot: Helck faces off with his former friend, Alicia. Meanwhile, Vermilio can't help but be concerned about Helck as she continues to fight with Raphaed.

meta.plot: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

meta.plot: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Swamp Eel
1.plot: When his wife loses money in a crypto scam, ex-gangster Felix Chiang looks for a way to make ends meet. Legislator Chao asks Ching He Temple for help.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Night and Day
1.plot: Facing a health crisis and mounting debt, Felix takes a lucrative job from the Ching He Temple. But it comes with a reluctant partner — Louis Hsueh.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Dog Eat Dog
1.plot: Felix and Louis investigate who leaked Sheng's secret videos, but Prosecutor Yen's hidden agenda threatens to derail their mission.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Fix
1.plot: Ching He Temple takes a case for the San He Association after boss Lin's disappearance sparks infighting, but Felix refuses to get involved.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - One Short
1.plot: Felix confronts someone from his past he can't forgive. Mina tasks Louis with tracking down a former fixer she once knew.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Diamond Ice
1.plot: With scammer Hung helping them, Felix, Louis and Mina make their play to get close to William. Thackeray conspires to keep the Hsueh family in check.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Tien-bu-la
1.plot: Mina and Louis discover the location where Gerald may be hiding, but they're not alone on their journey. Madam Fan sends Sir Hong an ominous warning.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Fake, Forsaken, Fraud
1.plot: As her allegiances fray, Mina seeks vengeance for her loved ones. A family health crisis pushes Louis to confront Tristan over the Hsuehs' secrets.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Backstabber
1.plot: With his wife and son in danger, Felix rushes to get them to safety. Madam Fan makes a grab for power, as Louis decides where his loyalties lie.

1.title: EN - The Fixers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Primordial Files
1.plot: As Madam Fan's masterplan nears its completion, Mina and Chiang make a move to try and stop her — but can they trust Louis to help?

meta.plot: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - God of Updates
1.plot: ER surgeon Fumi saves a young influencer's life — but her decision in the operating room sparks a firestorm that threatens to destroy her career.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Lift Those Lips
1.plot: On her first day at the clinic, Fumi clashes with director Rin, assists in surgeries she despises — and stumbles onto files that might help her situation.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Sculpting the Future
1.plot: A terminally ill widow requests a full transformation. As a camera crew captures every moment, Fumi questions how far a doctor should go for a patient.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Daughters
1.plot: How far should a parent push a child? A child YouTube star's upcoming surgery forces Rin to confront the price daughters pay for their fathers' dreams.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Sculpting the Past
1.plot: Pressure builds on every front. A blacklisted patient and a family crisis test Fumi's resolve, and Rin quietly forges a powerful new alliance.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Secrets
1.plot: A shattering loss forces Fumi to confront her past. Meanwhile, Rin's world begins to fracture as secrets emerge and alliances start to crumble.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Hand of God
1.plot: Rin fights back against her father and loses more than she bargained for. Fumi digs into her own past — and what she finds could upend both their lives.

1.title: EN - Plastic Beauty [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Deconstruction
1.plot: Both Rin and Fumi face seemingly insurmountable odds. As they fight to get back on their feet, the two women might decide what — and who — truly matters.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E01 - The Legend of the Emerald Blade
1.plot: Gilius Thunderhead leaves his questmates in search of the Emerald Blade.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E02 - Rideable Beasts
1.plot: Gilius and Hampton seek a Rideable Beast. Chronos embarrasses Ax and Tyris.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E03 - Tender Hamlet
1.plot: Gilius and Hampton visit a town where the villagers are suspiciously nice.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E04 - Fly Like an Eagle
1.plot: Gilius, Hampton, Ax, and Tyris fight the Bad Brothers aboard a giant eagle.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E05 - The Brothers Bad
1.plot: Hampton is taken prisoner. Ax, Tyris, and Chronos go on a side quest.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E06 - Return to Wenisburg
1.plot: Gilius and Hampton visit Hampton's hometown. Ax and Tyris go to the library.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E07 - The Cold Bard Truth
1.plot: A bard leaves Gilius out of his songs. Janzu must face his family.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E08 - Into the Cowoods
1.plot: Gilius and Hampton overcome their fears to escape a magical forest.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E09 - Because We're Us
1.plot: Gilius, Hampton, Ax, Tyris, Chronos, and Druda arrive at Death Adder's castle.

1.title: FR - Golden Axe - S01E10 - For Yuria
1.plot: In the season finale, Gilius realizes he cannot take on Death Adder alone.

meta.plot: Tiraillée entre son rôle de mère et sa carrière artistique, Funda est soulagée d'obtenir de l'aide. Mais sa mystérieuse nouvelle nounou pourrait bien cacher quelque chose.

meta.plot: Le sort du monde se joue lorsque s’affrontent le Maître des corps, un démon nécromancien ayant accumulé une puissance incommensurable, et un légendaire chevalier sacré. Mais, au dernier moment, le monstre use d’un mystérieux arcane magique qui enveloppe le héros d’une étrange lumière. À travers l'espace et le temps, un garçon nommé Polka Shinoyama se réveille en ne se sentant pas tout à fait lui-même… Qui pouvait s’attendre à ce que l’issue de la confrontation se déroule de cette façon ?

1.title: FR - Dead Mount Death Play - S01E01 - The Reincarnation
1.plot: A legendary necromancer known as the Corpse God is finally slain by a hero—only to wake up in the body of Polka Shinoyama, a newly assassinated boy in present-day Tokyo. Can the sorcerer survive in this strange new world?

1.title: FR - Dead Mount Death Play - S01E02 - The New World
1.plot: Polka scrambles to get his bearings while facing off against his would-be killer's colleagues. Is this the prelude to a new fight for survival or the start of an unlikely friendship?

1.title: FR - Dead Mount Death Play - S01E03 - The Necromancer
1.plot: Polka is settling into his new life when a man arrives begging Misaki to save him from gangsters. Polka sends her with him, but the job isn't what it seems. Meanwhile, other factions in Shinjuku investigate Polka's role in the fire.

1.title: FR - Dead Mount Death Play - S01E04 - The Mad Dog
1.plot: Polka's recent activities have caught the eye of a police unit dedicated to hunting down the most bizarre and seemingly superhuman offenders. To a peace-seeking necromancer, these cops could be worse trouble than the criminals he's fallen in with!

1.title: FR - Dead Mount Death Play - S01E05 - The Monster
1.plot: Just when he thought the cops were bad enough, Polka comes face to face with Lemmings, Shinjuku's most legendary criminal. Will Polka reveal his necromancy to save his new friends? And will his powers even be enough to save them if he does?

1.title: FR - Dead Mount Death Play - S01E06 - The Firestarter
1.plot: Keeping his promise to a ghost, Polka returns to his family's mansion with Misaki in tow. Can the necromancer fool the people who know the real Polka best? And can he save them from an unknown threat without arousing their suspicions?

meta.plot:
Depuis longtemps, Yûya Tenjô est victime de harcèlement. Il va au lycée tout en vivant seul dans la maison de son défunt grand-père. Malgré les violentes agressions qu'il subit, il trouve toujours du réconfort pendant les longues vacances.

Pendant cette période, alors qu'il nettoie la maison, il décide également de nettoyer la pièce où son grand-père conserve les objets qu'il a collectés tout au long de sa vie. Une pièce dans laquelle Yûya n'est jamais entré auparavant.

En essayant d'organiser les objets collectés par son grand-père, il trouve une mystérieuse porte qui semble avoir été découpée dans le mur. Par curiosité, il décide de l'ouvrir et découvre que cette porte l'emmène dans un autre monde où la magie existe.

1.title: FR - Cheat Skill Level Up - S01E01 - To Another World
1.plot: Yuuya Tenjou has been bullied all his life. Then he discovers a door to another world. Powerful weapons. Vicious monsters. It all seems like a fantasy game! And when he returns to his world, he realizes that his leveling up comes with him.

1.title: FR - Cheat Skill Level Up - S01E02 - Ousei Academy
1.plot: When Yuuya reunites with the girl he saved back at the convenience store, she invites him to attend the prestigious Ousei Academy. Yuuya isn’t sure that he’s worthy of attending a school full of geniuses, but he’s persuaded to try it for just one day.

1.title: FR - Cheat Skill Level Up - S01E03 - Life Changes
1.plot: Yuuya realizes that he doesn’t have many clothes that fit his new, leveled-up height. So, he heads to the mall where, in an unexpected turn of events, he ends up participating in a fashion photoshoot opposite a super popular female model?!

1.title: FR - Cheat Skill Level Up - S01E04 - A Step of Courage
1.plot: Yuya responds to Princess Lexia's marriage proposal and receives an invitation to an audience at the royal palace. At the same time, he returned to the Ôsei Academy.

1.title: FR - Cheat Skill Level Up - S01E05 - New Family
1.plot: As Yuuya tries to find a way to level up in the Darkest Regions, he comes across a Black Fenrir pup. Yuuya Tames him, names him Night, and brings him home to live together as family. Side by side, they explore the Darkest Regions...and also go for walks.

1.title: FR - Cheat Skill Level Up - S01E06 - The Sage and Magic
1.plot: Yuuya has found The Book of the Sage. As he reads it, he realizes that it’s even more amazing than it seems. Meanwhile, the class’s study trip draws near. Yuuya is at the department store with his friends to buy supplies when trouble suddenly strikes.

meta.plot: Takebayashi Ryôma, un ingénieur système célibataire de 39 ans exploité par son entreprise connaît une fin des plus saugrenues dans son petit appartement. Il se retrouve invité dans un autre monde par le dieu créateur, la déesse de l’amour et le dieu de la vie pour leur venir en aide, et le voilà réincarné en petit garçon dans un autre monde ! Ryôma, désormais âgé de 8 ans, vit paisiblement au cœur de la forêt et profite de sa nouvelle vie en se consacrant à l’étude des slimes apprivoisés grâce à sa magie. Voici l’histoire de son quotidien insouciant et amusant dans un nouveau monde entouré de bonnes personnes !

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E01 - Ryoma, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma Takebayashi is a young boy living by himself in a forest, who, in a previous lifetime, used to be a tortured middle-aged Japanese office worker. He meets a group of distressed travelers in the forest, and decides to save them.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E02 - Departure, with the Slimes
1.plot: It turns out that the travelers Ryoma saved were the local duke and his family. Impressed by Ryoma's various skills and enamored by his personality, they offer to take Ryoma along on their journey.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E03 - First Time in Town, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma and the Jamil family travel to Gimul, a mining town. There, Ryoma and Eliaria take the first steps in becoming professionals in their crafts. Ryoma is given another opportunity to flex his new powers.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E04 - Clean-Up Duty, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma arrives at Miya's house, overflowing with trash from a nearby dump. Ryoma and his slimes show a remarkable ability to clean, a skill that, as it turns out, the town of Gimul desperately needs.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E05 - The Lady's Training Session, with the Slimes
1.plot: Eliaria and Ryoma practice magic and combat in Gimul. They practice fighting against the weak but numerous monsters now infesting the abandoned mine shafts.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E06 - Monster Hunting, with the Slimes
1.plot: The Adventurer's Guild sets up a large-scale group of adventurers to deal with the massive monster infestation discovered in the abandoned mines. Ryoma joins them.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E07 - Starting the Business, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma decides to strike out on his own as an adventurer and business owner. He discusses his plans with the ducal family, and works with Serge the merchant to put his business plans in motion.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E08 - Laundry Business, with the Slimes
1.plot: The laundry business is ready to open. Ryoma hires new employees to help get his business started, and throws a party to express his thanks to the friends who have supported him thus far.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E09 - The New Coworkers, with the Slimes
1.plot: The laundry business explodes in popularity, so Ryoma rushes out on day two to hire more help. He meets Fei and Li Ling, foreigners with a hidden past.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E10 - The New Slimes, with the Slimes
1.plot: With the business going more smoothly than Ryoma ever imagined, Ryoma is able to go back to studying his slimes and adventuring. He discovers several new types of slimes.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E11 - Taming Training, with the Slimes
1.plot: The Jamil ducal family are all experts in the art of monster taming magic. Ryoma and Eliaria receive the Jamil elders' tutelage to further hone their taming magic.

1.title: FR - By the Grace of the Gods - S01E12 - The Beginning of a New Era, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma and Eliaria make another attempt to tame the limour birds. If they succeed, it would be a great milestone in their careers as monster tamers. However, whatever the outcome, their separation is inevitable as Eliaria leaves for school.

meta.plot: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

meta.plot: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

1.title: EN - The Grand Tour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Next Generation
1.plot: Thomas, James and Francis receive an official blessing from Jeremy Clarkson, then head off on their first-ever adventure. During the road trip across southern California, they compare three of the greatest performance cars America has ever created: the Ford Mustang GTD, Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 and Hennessey Venom F5 Revolution Evolution. By racing against fighter jets, obviously.

1.title: EN - The Grand Tour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Sweat, Sports Cars and Singapore
1.plot: Thomas, Francis and James journey from futuristic Singapore to the Malaysian highlands to investigate an important consumer question: for less than £5,000, is it possible to buy a sports car that's exciting to drive but also won't break down the whole time?

1.title: EN - The Grand Tour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - It's OK to Be Kei
1.plot: Following a pub chat with James May, the team head stateside to convince Americans of the brilliance of tiny Japanese Kei cars. And what better way for Thomas, James and Francis to win hearts and minds... than by sneaking off-road around Colorado before tackling the USA's most terrifying hillclimb: the 4,300-metre monster that is Pikes Peak?

1.title: EN - The Grand Tour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Last Car Standing
1.plot: The hosts are on a mission to find out the strongest car ever made. After a series of very destructive tests they enlist the help of Richard Hammond to help them crown the winner. Elsewhere, Thomas and Francis test out a classic Alfa Romeo and Subaru that have been 'restomodded' at enormous expense.

1.title: EN - The Grand Tour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Relaxing Spa Weekend
1.plot: It's hypercar versus train as Thomas, James, and Francis race a Pagani Utopia against public transport from Britain to the Belgian Grand Prix, with an urgent delivery for Williams F1 driver Alex Albon. Elsewhere, James uncovers the incredible story of the BMW Isetta and its Cold War heroics.

1.title: EN - The Grand Tour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Angola: Survive to Drive
1.plot: Thomas, James and Francis head to Angola in a trio of deeply inappropriate track cars, in a bid to discover whether this corner of southern Africa is truly a hidden hotbed of back-to-basics motorsport. Will they discover racing in the wild desert? Or just a whole lot of sand and getting stuck?

meta.plot: Le destin d'une famille sur plusieurs générations à travers le XXe siècle en Italie. Une saga familiale qui explore l’identité, les origines et la transmission.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: 1917. Maurizio Sartori, a deserter on the run, takes refuge at the Tassan farmhouse and falls in love with Nadia, who decides to keep his secret. However, after the end of World War I, Nadia discovers she is pregnant, and he chooses to flee.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: 1919. Nadia is reunited with Maurizio, and after forgiving him, she marries him. Maurizio starts working at the factory, where he befriends Leone, but a clash with the fascists leads to both of their arrests. Sartori avoids arrest by denying that he is a deserter, but he sinks into alcoholism. Meanwhile, the family grows with the arrival of Gabriele, Domenico, and Renzo.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: 1930. Maurizio is blackmailed by the fascists, the Becchiarutti family, who have discovered his past desertion: he tries to resist, but faced with the threat to his children, he is forced to betray Leone and the other communists, who are sent into exile. Meanwhile, Nadia loses her job as Edda’s nanny after Edda is struck and killed by a car.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: 1938. The children are now grown, and Nadia senses that war is coming, while Maurizio—tormented by guilt over his past betrayal—runs into Leone, who has just returned from exile. One evening, while his wife and children are at the movie theater’s opening night, Maurizio helps a woman on the street and shortly afterward collapses to the ground, overcome by the bitter cold.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: 1943. Maurizio has been dead for some time, and his sons Renzo and Gabriele have doubts about him because they’re beginning to realize that he was a deserter, despite their mother’s reassurances. Renzo wants to join the Resistance and Leone’s group, but his mother is against it because he is still a minor. Gabriele begins a relationship with a girl named Margherita, and just as he is about to go to war, he is stopped because the armistice is signed on September 8. Domenico, on the other hand, dies in Africa after having a vision of his father.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: May 1945. Gabriele can no longer bear to stay in hiding; he emerges from his hiding place, is reunited with his Margherita, and—to be forgiven for desertion—enlists in the German army. Renzo, on the other hand, is hiding in the mountains with Leone’s group, even though his mother urges him to return home because he has gotten a girl, Federica Drigo, pregnant. The group heads down into the valley to free some female partisans but runs into enemy soldiers; Leone, after saving Renzo, is fatally wounded. Meanwhile, during a house search, Gabriele rebels and kills a German soldier, freeing a group of Italians who were hiding there. Shortly afterward, Gabriele, Margherita, Flaviut, and Renzo return home because the war is over.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: 1955. The war has been over for ten years now. Gabriele is a schoolteacher and still lives in the small village with his mother, Margherita, and his daughter, Eloisa, while Renzo lives on the streets of Turin as a homeless man until he finds work at Teresa’s inn. Years later, Gabriele runs into Federica Drigo again and discovers that she has a son named Luigi and that she hates his family—something he cannot understand.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: 1961. Gabriele runs into Luigi on the street—Renzo’s illegitimate son, who was raised by Flaviut (Leone’s son, now in prison) and Federica—and takes him under his wing. At Eloisa’s First Communion, Grandma Nadia gets to meet her daughter-in-law Teresa but doesn’t see Renzo, who still doesn’t want to see her. Shortly afterward, Teresa discovers by pure chance that Renzo has cheated on her with a journalist from *L’Unità* whom he had met some time earlier, so she shows up at the factory and exposes him in front of his coworkers. Renzo then decides to return to Friuli to his mother after fifteen years of silence: she welcomes him back into the house, deeply moved, and scolds him for his actions.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: 1975. Eloisa studies law and frequents anarchist circles, where she meets Luigi, a newly graduated doctor whose father, Flaviut, remains in prison. Davide focuses on bodybuilding, while Libero and Diana navigate adolescence. Renzo wakes up in the hospital, saved by Luigi. When Sartori confesses to Luigi that he is his real father, the young doctor reacts bitterly, forcing Sartori to cancel his upcoming marriage to Eloisa via letter. Undeterred, Eloisa joins student protests and visits Flaviut in prison. Gabriele tries to reconnect with Davide, only to discover his boxing coach is Margherita’s ex-boyfriend—a revelation that deepens their rift and leads to their separation. Diana falls for Sandra after a club performance and stuns her father by deciding to move in with her. Meanwhile, newlyweds Libero and Marta welcome a baby girl, Nadia, shortly before Marta departs for Africa.

1.title: FR - Les Sartori, une histoire italienne - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: 1978. Nadia dies after suddenly falling ill at her farmhouse, and the whole family rushes to her side in despair, with Renzo feeling the most anger. Luigi comforts Eloisa as she has a panic attack and tells her that he is Renzo’s son—and therefore her cousin. Gabriele urges his daughter not to let Luigi slip away, just as he did with Margherita. Eloisa and Luigi then reunite and read a letter from Grandma Nadia that Gabriele hadn’t had the courage to open, in which she recounts many details of her relationship with her husband. During this family reunion, Renzo and Gabriele find peace with their wives and children. Finally, Davide takes in a young woman who has fled East Berlin, just as Nadia had done with Maurizio sixty years earlier.

meta.plot: Corinne Maillard dirige la détention de Chénoise avec un idéalisme à toute épreuve. Entourée de Jeff, son bras droit procédurier, JP, surveillant qui se sent plus à l'aise avec les détenus qu'avec ses collègues, et Stéphanie, nouvelle recrue qu'elle prend sous son aile, elle jongle entre imprévus quotidiens et hiérarchie tatillonne. Convaincue que chaque détenu mérite une seconde chance, elle est la seule personne à penser que la prison peut rendre les hommes meilleurs.

meta.plot: "The Drop: A Snowfall Saga" retrouve Wanda Bell et Leon Simmons de "Snowfall" en pleine réinvention dans le Los Angeles des années 90. Alors que les ravages du crack s'estompent, un nouveau jeu émerge : l'essor du rap de la côte Ouest. Convaincue que la musique peut changer la culture américaine, Wanda rassemble une bande de génies hétéroclites pour réaliser leurs rêves. Pour y arriver, elle doit naviguer entre le monde de la musique et les codes de la rue, entraînant ses cousins Lamar et James Kinsey et courtisant Artillery, un rappeur local au sang chaud déjà dans le viseur de la police. Son stage chez l'ex-dealer devenu patron de label Darryl "DG" Grant lui ouvre des portes, mais creuse les tensions avec Leon. Ce dernier a juré de quitter la rue pour de bon et cherche la rédemption via son cabinet d'aide juridique gratuit. Ambition, loyauté et survie s'entrechoquent : chacun est prêt à tout risquer pour bâtir un avenir.

1.title: FR - The Drop: A Snowfall Saga (VOSTFR) - S01E01 - Click Pop
1.plot: Wanda wants to break into L.A.'s booming rap scene. She stakes her future on her cousin, Lamar, and a rising rapper, Artillery. Leon warns Wanda of the danger of the music business.

meta.plot: La mangaka Aya Kanno (Otomen) propose une interprétation inédite de Richard III, la pièce de Shakespeare, dans laquelle le héros est hermaphrodite ! Dès sa naissance, Richard, héritier de la prestigieuse famille de York, est un enfant rejeté de tous. Mais tout bascule quand son père s'engage dans un conflit pour le trône. De cette guerre va émerger un tyran sanguinaire, qui marquera l'histoire de l'Angleterre…

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E01 - Wars of the Roses
1.plot: Civil war grips Medieval England as the houses of York and Lancaster vie for the throne. Richard, the Duke of York's youngest son, wants nothing more than to see his father crowned king, but he struggles with a secret that he fears to confront.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E02 - Father Is My Light
1.plot: Richard desires to stand on the battlefield with his father, the Duke of York, but his mother Cecily denies him this wish. "Your words will become a curse, one that spells doom for others." Locked in a tower, Richard discovers that King Henry VI of the House of Lancaster is also housed inside. He fervently hopes to kill him and offer his crown to his father...but meanwhile, the Duke of York is taken captive after a fierce battle against Queen Margaret and her Lancaster forces.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E03 - I Am the Shadow, the Darkness Behind the Light
1.plot: The Duke of York is dead. The Earl of Warwick pushes the late duke's eldest son Edward as king, and Edward steps up to the responsibility. The decisive battle between the Houses of York and Lancaster takes place outside of London, and Richard is there, once again swinging his sword in search of blood. "In the darkness, all I see is the color of blood. That is why I must fill it all in..." As blood rains down like rose petals, the battle ends with the House of York victorious -- and the kingmaking Earl of Warwick is already planning Edward's marriage.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E04 - I’m Afraid I’m Going to Lose the Answers I’ve Gotten and...Everything Else
1.plot: Edward has fallen in love with Elizabeth, a widower and lower-ranked noblewoman who approached him at a party. He meets her in secret on many occasions, disguising their encounters as hunting sessions. One day, as he accompanies Edward, Richard meets Henry, the young shepherd he once met before. Neither know who the other truly is, but they find themselves together after fleeing to a villa to avoid a rainstorm. "I don't care who you are," Henry says. "It's you yourself that I like, after all." Richard responds with stony silence, as the rain continues deep into the night.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E05 - If I Don’t Grab Your Hand, I Won’t Have to Let Go
1.plot: The wedding of Edward and Elizabeth has opened a vast rift between the House of York and the Earl of Warwick. The repurcussions continue at a later dinner party, where Richard meets the Duke of Buckingham. "Richard," the duke says, "has it ever occurred to you? You, too, could become king...!" The advice throws Richard, but in his mind, the words of his father the Duke of York ring loudly: "Let my name live on...the name of the king." Then, as Richard stands before his father's portrait, the Earl of Warwick steps in.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E06 - A man who has no awareness as king... A man who is not qualified to be king... Neither of them is fit for the throne.
1.plot: Elizabeth gives birth to a baby girl, as Edward and his younger brother George grow more and more hostile toward each other. Meanwhile, the Earl of Warwick pushes a wedding between his second daughter Isabelle and George, bringing him even closer to his former enemies in the House of Lancaster. Queen Margaret challenges Warwick to prove his sincerity by offering his eldest daughter Anne's hand in marriage to Edward of Westminster, from the House of Lancaster. But before he commits, Edward has someone he must meet first -- Richard, a man already well familiar to him.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E07 - Even if I sin...
1.plot: Richard's elder brother Edward has been taken prisoner. On the way to rescue Edward, Richard meets Prince Edward of the House of Lancaster. The two decide to travel together, even as they both hide their identities from each other. On the way, Prince Edward asks "Have you ever wanted to get your hands on something, even if it meant committing a crime?" The words silently echo in Richard's mind as the two arrive at Middleham Castle, where Edward is being held.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E08 - Even alone, it wasn’t frightening. Rather... the loneliness has been kind ever since losing Father.
1.plot: Henry VI is back on the throne, but so far it has only been a return to the days that tormented him. Meanwhile, Edward orders Richard to deliver the banner of the House of York as an ultimatum to Warwick and his brother George, who has joined the House of Lancaster. Richard's group acts in secret, but a Lancastrian nobleman discovers their York affiliation and they cross swords. Wounded in the battle, Richard unexpectedly runs into Henry, who is on a pilgrimage.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E09 - I remember when Christmas was approaching. The time when I lost Father.
1.plot: In the moonlit forest, the darkness of the night envelops Richard and Henry. But their time together doesn't last long, as Richard leaves with the newly-arriving Catesby. "I promise you we'll meet under that tree again," Henry says. Emotionally wrought, Richard promises to meet him again and heads for George's home. Meanwhile George, drunk and wondering where he went wrong in life, sees the ghost of his father, the Duke of York.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E10 - My name is Richard Plantagenet.
1.plot: Anne is ordered by the Earl of Warwick to marry Prince Edward. There is no love between the two of them, but their friendship begins to grow as they discuss their true feelings for each other during a boat trip. Meanwhile, the Earl of Warwick finally confronts Edward on the battlefield. Warwick has the numerical advantage, but George, once aligned with the Lancaster faction, sides with Edward again, evening up the odds. As the battle stalls, Richard takes the place of Buckingham and stages a solo attack on Lancaster's camp.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E11 - That is my… my punishment…
1.plot: Richard discovers that the man from the forest is Henry VI of Lancaster, the one who killed Richard's father. Torn between fond feelings for Henry and the betrayal of York, Richard murmurs "die." "If you're in that much of a hurry to die," says Buckingham, "go ahead and keep killing in your rage." To Richard, however, this is nothing more than a punishment to bear. Meanwhile, Queen Margaret of Lancaster continues to fight, but realizing her disadvantage, she decides to entrust the life of Prince Edward to Anne.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E12 - Richard is dead, died alone in the woods that day.
1.plot: Edward becomes king, and York is overjoyed...but Richard's heart was sinking. "The light will never return." Richard goes to the prison where Henry was captured, even after receiving orders from Edward to kill Henry. "You've always appeared out of nowhere...healing my wounds, then tearing them open." With dagger in hand, Richard emotionally opens up to Henry. But what will Henry say when Richard reveals the greatest secret of all?

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E13 - After all, this body is just a prison of the soul...
1.plot: Ten years later, King Edward IV enjoys a future-predicting "destiny cake" at a banquet. The cake he grabbed was in the shape of a "G," but what does the wine-red "G" suggest about the future? At the banquet, Edward IV meets a woman named Jane. Meanwhile Richard, reappearing at the royal palace after many years, has married Anne, their son Edward growing up healthy and happy. But their happiness is only superficial. "When my soul died, I knew rest, for without a soul, there is no captivity."

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E14 - Good night. Brother.
1.plot: Richard captures George for cursing Edward IV. However, Edward IV keeps hoping that George might come to his senses. Richard makes a decision: "Buckingham, kill George." Now Richard must convince Edward IV that it was the Woodville family that sent George to his death. George, cornered by Richard and Buckingham's plot, storms into the courtroom.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E15 - If you hide it, you won’t feel sadness.
1.plot: Richard is now taking care of Edward IV...but upon the king's death, Queen Elizabeth's brother Anthony plans to install a child prince as king and himself as regent. Anthony also attempts to arrest Richard for treason, but Buckingham also lurks behind the shadows. Finally, Buckingham learns the secret of Richard, who then reveals a dream: "If you can't escape your fate...then become the devil."

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E16 - The devil has the devil's way.
1.plot: Richard and Buckingham embark on a majority-rule maneuver to gain the throne. It creates more suffering for Catesby, who has been trying to protect Richard while serving Hastings. Who is his loyalty truly for? Meanwhile, Hastings and the Queen Mother are planning a service for King Edward V. The service would publicize and solidify Elizabeth's power if held, and now Richard is gradually pushed into a position of inferiority.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E17 - Because God has chosen this bloody demon.
1.plot: Hastings and the Queen Mother carry out a plan to disqualify Richard...but it's revealed that Edward V, son of Edward IV and Elizabeth, had no rightful claim to the throne. So Edward V and his brother are imprisoned in the Tower of London. Thus Richard steadily closes in on the throne...but Cecily agitates the people against it, stating "the devil must not be made king!" Faced with throngs of angry citizens, Richard and Buckingham put on the play of the century.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E18 - Your name.
1.plot: Anne witnesses Richard coming out of Buckingham's room at night. "You know him better than anyone," she says to Catesby. "If he's hiding something, please tell me." To root out Richard's secret, Anne proposes that he dress as a woman and she as a man at a banquet they call "The Devil's Paradise." Despite Anne's intentions, the banquet is a great success, the two of them lost among the admiring crowd. Then Buckingham appears, dressed as the devil.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E19 - I will protect Edward. That child is my son.
1.plot: At a rainy villa, a night spent with Henry VI springs back to Richard's memory. Buckingham, knowing who Richard once loved, joins hands with the king. "Say the name," he tells him, "my name." The villa is visited by Tyrell, the assassin who took George and the others. Buckingham is shocked when he realizes Tyrell is the spitting image of Henry VI. Meanwhile, in London, Richmond is on the move for the throne.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E20 - The light is overhead.
1.plot: Rumors circulate that Richard is not the rightful king. This story leads to the escape of Edward V, son of the previous king, and his brother from the Tower of London. Richard suffers from poor health as he prepares for his coronation in York. A medical examination by the imprisoned witch Jane suggests a certain possibility. With that in mind, Richard visits Buckingham's castle. There, Buckingham's love for Richard grows to the point where he takes unprecedented action. "I can no longer keep my cool with you around."

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E21 - It should still be in time now.
1.plot: Buckingham, determined to rebel, tries to win the cooperation of Bishop Ely and Stanley. Meanwhile, Richmond advises his father-in-law Stanley of the conditions under which he will join the rebellion. Those conditions: The death of King Edward V and his brother, who are imprisoned in the Tower of London. Buckingham believes Richard III, and no one else, must commit the murders. At the same time, Richard enters York and waits for Buckingham, who is expected to come. However, after the coronation, Richard is visited by the assassin Tyrell.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E22 - Use your head more, damn brat. Don't die even if you are weak.
1.plot: With Buckingham in open rebellion, an anguished Richard turns toward Catesby. "If only I hadn't been so intimate with him. If only I wasn't the son of the devil..." But that was no longer an option. Leaving his wife Anne and son Edward behind, Richard sets out for battle. Richard III and Buckingham cross swords in the Forest of Dean, just as they promised. "I will cross the border and abandon my name. I will stand by your side and cut through your thorns until the day I die. That...and the loyalty to your father that still binds you..."

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E23 - Mother ...... Goodbye.
1.plot: Just as Richard has personally seen to the end of Buckingham, Anne confesses that her tuberculosis has returned. Anne begs Richard to disinherit their kind-hearted son Edward in order to protect him. Facing the cruel fate of loved ones drifting away, Richard desperate enough for the departed Buckingham to try replacing him with Catesby. But Catesby says he cannot, for "the heat of the body cannot warm the soul." In the midst of this, the battle with Richmond approaches.

1.title: FR - Le Requiem du Roi des Roses - S01E24 - Requiem of the Rose King
1.plot: "If this name, if this blood, was all an illusion...then what is the point of this battle?" Richard looks back at his past, guided by Tyrell in front of him. "Let us go home, even if it is a battlefield where not even sleep is allowed to us..."

meta.plot: Dans ce monde du XXe siècle, le théâtre tient une importance toute particulière et de premier plan où les artistes les plus brillants sont appelés Dai Stars. La jeune adolescente Kokona Ôtori rêve de monter un jour sur les planches. Cultivant son sens unique de la mise en scène, elle entame ses premiers pas vers la célébrité en participant à une audition pour la célèbre troupe Sirius.

1.title: FR - Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star - S01E01 - The Girl with Dreams
1.plot: Young Kokona Otori has always dreamed of being a star—a World Dai Star! She’s been told she doesn’t have what it takes, but a chance to show her stuff in front of the legendary all-female acting troupe SIRIUS may change everything!

1.title: FR - Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star - S01E02 - Copying Someone Else
1.plot: If Kokona thought making it into the SIRIUS acting troupe would be the hardest part of achieving her dream, she was wrong! She’s already got her next big challenge ahead of her—landing her first role!

1.title: FR - Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star - S01E03 - Our First Play
1.plot: Preparing for her first role has got Kokona doing some soul-searching. Can a little bit of self-discovery help her become someone else on the stage?

1.title: FR - Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star - S01E04 - Once Upon a Time
1.plot: Kokona may have made it through her first play, but now the other girls are looking for answers. Just who is Shizuka?

1.title: FR - Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star - S01E05 - A Wish
1.plot: SIRIUS is planning their next production and to everyone's surprise, Kokona is picked as the lead rather than Yae.

1.title: FR - Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star - S01E06 - No One Is Looking at Me
1.plot: Kokona is completely absorbed in her first lead role, which may not end up being a good thing for her performance...

meta.plot: The theatrical film that continues directly from Season 3 of Kaguya-sama: Love Is War, split into four episodes for streaming and home media. After years of romantic mind games, the two geniuses of Shuchiin Academy's student council — Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane — finally shared a kiss at the culture festival. But neither of them actually confessed, and with no clear words spoken, their relationship remains completely undefined. Now painfully aware of each other's every move, the would-be couple faces the greatest battlefield of all: Christmas. Shirogane is determined to engineer the perfect first date, while Kaguya finds herself drawn to something imperfect and real. This is the very "normal" love story of two geniuses — and a first kiss that never ends.

1.title: FR - Kaguya-sama: Love Is War The First Kiss That Never Ends - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In the aftermath of the culture festival, Kaguya spirals into panic over the kiss she gave Shirogane, convinced it went much further than a first kiss should. Sleep-deprived and overwhelmed, she regresses into a childlike state of pure feelings, while Shirogane anxiously tries to figure out where the two of them now stand.

1.title: FR - Kaguya-sama: Love Is War The First Kiss That Never Ends - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: To protect herself, Kaguya locks her emotions away entirely, and a cold, calculating version of her takes control. Shaken by how completely she has changed overnight, Shirogane refuses to let it go — confronting her, chasing her through the school, and finally telling her exactly what he thinks.

1.title: FR - Kaguya-sama: Love Is War The First Kiss That Never Ends - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: A lunchtime standoff over Shirogane's homemade bento pulls the two closer together than either of them planned, until Kaguya's boldness proves too much and Shirogane passes out cold. Sitting at his bedside, the competing sides of Kaguya's heart wage war over what she truly wants from him.

1.title: FR - Kaguya-sama: Love Is War The First Kiss That Never Ends - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Christmas Eve arrives. After enjoying the Fujiwara family's chaotic brand of holiday hospitality, Kaguya and Shirogane head home together and end up side by side on a park bench — where two people who could never say what they mean finally have the honest conversation that defines their relationship.
